# BWPT.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp303.0 against Rp78.0 (expected total return 291.6%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: commodity_capex_turnaround · method card: per fund record routing for Plantations (palm oil).

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- FY2026E EBITDA of Rp2,122.6bn cannot be reconciled with the nine months actually filed. 9M 2026 EBIT was Rp1,015.475bn (S7 p.6) plus D&A of Rp349.272bn (mature-plantation amortisation 230.850 plus depreciation 118.422, S
- The ten-year cost base is 5% below the filing. cost_per_bcm of Rp12.4m/t is justified in the assumptions by the 9M COGS ratio of 74.4%, but 74.4% implies about Rp13.0m/t: 9M COGS 4,007.778 less D&A 349.272 equals 3,658.5
- The EV/EBITDA cross-check is struck on an EBITDA the analyst itself knows to be corrupted. The engine metric is the data pack LTM of Rp1,345.8bn, the sum of Q4 2025 and Q1-Q3 2026 with quarterly D&A of 2.5-3.5bn; the fil

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
